# Manifest

*Generated by `make manifest`. Verify a checkout with `uv run verify-manifest`.*

- schema version **5**
- built from commit `853a06dc47a1` **(dirty)** — necessarily the parent of the commit holding this file
- 1,543,813 pooled seat-event records, 2,225,289 candidates, 85,191 supplemental rows, and 176,237 local parsed rows
- written by **pyarrow 23.0.1** — parquet records its writer in every footer, so a different version changes every hash below without changing a value

## Schema

`master_columns` records the exact ordered column list, so a consumer can detect a schema change without diffing a header:

```
dataset_id, row_id, seat_key, seat_key_unique, state, year, election_type, election_duration, district, block, body, gp_no, gram_panchayat, gp_term, ward_no, ward_name, seat_no, district_latin, district_latin_method, block_latin, block_latin_method, gram_panchayat_latin, gram_panchayat_latin_method, tier, tier_local, reserved_caste, reserved_caste_local, reserved_caste_scheme, reserved_woman, reserved_label, reserved_raw, listing_scope, unit_of_observation, seat_candidates, winner, winner_latin, winner_latin_method, winner_basis, votes, runner_up, runner_up_votes, margin, vacant, unopposed, script, source_repo, source_commit, source_path, source_page, provenance_level, quality_flags
```

`candidate_columns` does the same for the long candidate tables:

```
dataset_id, candidate_id, row_id, seat_key, candidate_no, state, year, election_type, election_duration, district, block, body, gp_no, gram_panchayat, ward_no, seat_no, tier, tier_local, reserved_caste, reserved_woman, candidate_name, relation_name, candidate_woman_raw, candidate_woman, candidate_age, candidate_caste, candidate_education, candidate_marital_status, candidate_occupation, candidate_total_assets, candidate_children_before_1995_11_27, candidate_children_after_1995_11_27, party, votes, candidate_rank, elected, result, source_repo, source_commit, source_path, source_page
```
